title: ごろ ／ ぐらい・くらい
meaning: ごろ = "around / about" a point in time; ぐらい (くらい) = "about / approximately" an amount or duration.
simpleExplanation: ごろ and ぐらい both mean "about", but for different things. ごろ is for a point in time: 七時ごろ "around seven o'clock". ぐらい (also くらい) is for an amount or a length of time: 十分ぐらい "about ten minutes", 三十人ぐらい "about thirty people". The test question to ask: is it a clock time or date (ごろ) or a quantity (ぐらい)?
whenUsed: Estimating when you get up, how long a trip takes, how many people came, how much something costs.
formation: Time point + ごろ　／　Quantity・Duration + ぐらい

examples.ja: 毎朝七時ごろ起きます。
examples.reading: まいあさ しちじごろ おきます。
examples.en: I get up at around seven every morning.

examples.ja: 駅まで歩いて十分ぐらいかかります。
examples.reading: えきまで あるいて じゅっぷんぐらい かかります。
examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to walk to the station.

examples.ja: 学生が三十人ぐらい来ました。
examples.reading: がくせいが さんじゅうにんぐらい きました。

examples.ja: このかばんは五千円ぐらいでした。
examples.reading: この かばんは ごせんえんぐらいでした。

examples.ja: 来月の十日ごろに国へ帰ります。
examples.reading: らいげつの とおかごろに くにへ かえります。
examples.en: I'm going back to my country around the 10th of next month.
examples.note: A date is a point in time → ごろ.

similarGrammar.difference: ごろ can be followed by に or not: 七時ごろ(に)起きます.
ぐらい follows a number + counter.

commonMistakes.why: A duration is an amount → ぐらい.

commonMistakes.wrong: 七時ぐらい (as the tested answer)
commonMistakes.why: Clock times take ごろ on the exam, even though ぐらい is heard in speech.
Money is an amount → ぐらい.

usageNotes: Classic exam contrast: 三時ごろ (around 3 o'clock — point in time) vs 三時間ぐらい (about 3 hours — duration). ×七時ぐらいに is heard in speech but ごろ is the tested form for clock times. どのぐらい／どのくらい = "how long / how much".
jlptTips: 時 (o'clock) → ごろ; 時間 (hours) → ぐらい. This single contrast appears almost every year.
People, yen, minutes, kilometres, pages: all amounts → ぐらい.
